notes:
Background: Vela CX Collective runs 24/7 support for several large retail brands. Already using small Redwood hosted setup for search/embeddings in support portal (non-critical). They want to expand to contact-center workloads (agent-assist + live summarization + tool-calling) for 4 regional contact centers (NA, EU, APAC).

Key asks / constraints:
- Low p99 latency for agent assist (target end-to-end < 150ms for token streaming where possible).
- Predictable throughput during Black Friday style spikes (currently worried about 10x baseline spikes).
- Data residency: EU customer transcripts cannot leave EU region for storage/long-term logs.
- SSO/SAML and central audit logs mandatory. KMS integration for keys.
- Must support function/tool calling to execute agent actions in existing CRM/ticketing (Zendesk + internal tools).

Recent timeline (shorthand):
- 2025-11-05: initial intro call (Alex) — demo of hosted embeddings; interested in agent assist.
- 2025-12-12: security questionnaire sent; legal flagged residency question.
- 2026-01-20: scoped POC: dedicated pool for 50 concurrent agents (NA pilot). Fireflies: ff_20260218_vela_intro.

Notes from security call: "We need encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys + audit logs pushed to our SIEM. If Redwood can provide per-customer keystore mapping and regional storage, that's a big win."

POC results quick summary: agent assist quality good on instruction-tuned open model; ticket summarization reduces agent wrap time by ~22% in pilot; tool-calling integration prototype works via webhook relay (needs hardened auth and retry semantics).

Commercials / asks from Vela:
- Committed monthly throughput for NA pilot (50 agents) then scale to 400 agents across regions in Q4. Wants option to burst to extra capacity during promotional events.
- Looking for dedicated capacity with clear SLA and fallback to hosted variants for failover.

Next steps (short):

- Procurement clarifies data residency acceptance criteria (Diego owning).
- Finance to sign off burst pricing model (Alex + Redwood rev ops).

Sales play / suggested Redwood approach: Push Dedicated + Optimize bundle; propose regional dedicated pools (EU + NA) with automatic routing and fallback to hosted API; include optional Private deployment for EU long-term archive. Emphasize cost control via caching/batching recommendations and include a brief on expected unit economics under burst scenarios.
